entries.text: 帝高辛之妃，偰母號也。从女戎聲。《詩》曰：“有娀方將。”
戌 here a variant of 戈# halberd + 女 woman → exercise *authority* over a woman → *dignity*; *majesty*.
姑也。从女从戌。漢律曰：“婦告威姑。”
As per 圭# (neat) + 女 woman → woman of neat, attractive appearance (compare 佳) → *beautiful woman* → *beautiful*.
圜深目皃。或曰吳楚之閒謂好曰娃。从女圭聲。

甹# is 丂 as described in 号 (extend then bend) + 由. Here, 由 replaces an obsolete element of uncertain signification, leaving the original sense of 甹 unclear. (In Chinese, the present-day meanings are "make one's feelings known" and "chivalrous knight." In Japanese, 甹 is not used independently.) However, the Old Chinese pronunciation suggests that 甹 was connected with the broad concept "spread extensively" (compare 方 丙 平 etc.) and more specifically with the idea of visiting or calling upon someone (compare 訪). 娉 adds 女 woman → pay a visit to obtain and bring home a bride → *take a bride*. Also, *call* and *invite*.
問也。从女甹聲。
小小侵也。从女肖聲。
娎㛍也。从女折聲。

沙# (fine) sand + 女 woman → the fine motions of a dancing woman (compare 倢 and 婕). In Japanese, 娑 bears no independent meaning, but appears in compounds such as 娑婆 (← the comings and goings of this world).
舞也。从女沙聲。《詩》曰：“市也媻娑。”
女師也。从女𣫭聲。讀若母。
順也。从女尾聲。讀若𡡾。
謹也。从女束聲。讀若謹敕數數。
女出病也。从女廷聲。
As per 良# (pure) + 女 woman → pure young female → *girl* → *daughter*. Compare 孃.
長好也。从女坙聲。
樂也。从女吳聲。
As per 那# (supple) + 女 woman → supple, *graceful* woman → *elegant*; *captivating*.
不肖也。从女否聲。讀若竹皮箁。
As per 肙# as described in 絹 (reel/unwind) + 女 woman → undulating, *curvaceous female figure* → *beautiful*. Compare 媛.
嬋娟也。从女肙聲。
As per 辰# (twitch) + 女 woman → twitching of a fetus → *pregnancy*.
女妊身動也。从女辰聲。《春秋傳》曰：“后緡方娠。”一曰宮婢女隸謂之娠。

As per 弟# (vertical alignment) + 女 woman → female occupying a lower stage in a hierarchy → *younger sister*; *sister-in-law* (wife of one's younger brother). With respect to females low in a hierarchy, compare 姨.
女弟也。从女从弟，弟亦聲。
As per 我# (bladed weapon → blade-like) + 女 woman → *beautiful visage*; *beautiful* (← beautifully chiseled features).
帝堯之女，舜妻娥皇字也。秦晉謂好曰娙娥。从女我聲。
好也。从女兌聲。
As per 免# (give birth) + 女 woman → *give birth*. 娩 was devised to express the original sense of 免 after the latter underwent its transformation of meanings.
戲也。从女矣聲。一曰卑賤名也。
As per 呉# (rowdy) + 女 woman → enjoy a woman in rowdy circumstances → *pleasure*; *enjoyment*. 娯 was devised to replace 呉.
As per 取# (take hold of) + 女 woman → *take as a bride*; *marry*.
取婦也。从女从取，取亦聲。
諉也。从女垂聲。
人姓也。从女其聲。杜林說：娸，醜也。
有守也。从女弦聲。
疾悍也。从女叕聲。讀若唾。
As per 昌# (chant; recite) + 女 woman → woman entertaining by singing (compare 倡) → *prostitute*.
隨從也。从女彔聲。
媕娿也。从女阿聲。
As per 阿# (bend) + 女 woman → *sinuous*/*graceful* woman who bends her body alluringly → *beautiful*.

The relevant seal inscription form is 母 mother (→ producer of a succession of individuals) + an element# combining 中 center/middle and 女 woman → continuum of stooped female slaves tied to a central restraint and dragged along → *tie*; *drag*; *connect*.
空也。从母、中、女，空之意也。一曰婁，務也。
As per 波# (breaking waves) + 女 woman → *elderly woman* (likened to a wave that has already crested and broken).
宛# bend + 女 woman → the *graceful* figure of a bending (= supple) woman → *gentle*; *beautiful*. For the coupling of "supple" and "beauty," compare 鵷.
順也。从女宛聲。《春秋傳》曰：“太子痤婉。”
姿婎，姿也。从女隹也。一曰醜也。
兔子也。婏，疾也。从女、兔。
㛂也。一曰女侍曰婐。讀若騧，或若委。从女果聲。孟軻曰：“舜爲天子，二女婐。”
往來婓婓也。一曰醜皃。从女非聲。
疌# as described in 倢 (nimble) + 女 woman → the *attractive* motions of a nimble woman.
女字也。从女疌聲。
嫛婗也。从女兒聲。一曰婦人惡皃。
As per 昏# (darkness) + 女 woman → *wedding ceremony* (held in the darkness of night) → *marriage*.
婦家也。《禮》：娶婦以昏時，婦人陰也，故曰婚。从女从昏，昏亦聲。
美也。从女臤聲。
很也。从女幸聲。《楚詞》曰：“鯀婞直。”
嫪也。从女固聲。
體德好也。从女官聲。讀若楚卻宛。
卑# low + 女 woman → (lowly) *female servant*. Compare 俾.
女之卑者也。从女从卑，卑亦聲。
女字也。从女周聲。
As per 卓# (rise above) + 女 woman → woman of surpassing (delicate) *beauty*.
女病也。从女卓聲。
帚# sweep + 女 woman → woman sweeping/doing housework (compare 妻) → *woman*; *wife*.
服也。从女持帚灑掃也。
竦立也。从女青聲。一曰有才也。讀若韭菁。
As per 林# (encompass) + 女 woman → be encompassed with craving for a woman → *covetous*; *ravenous*.
貪也。从女林聲。杜林說：卜者黨相詐驗爲婪。讀若潭。
私逸也。从女㸒聲。
不繇也。从女敄聲。
不順也。从女若聲。《春秋傳》曰：“叔孫婼。”
兪# remove + 女 woman → woman removing an object → *steal* (compare 偸). *Enjoy* is a borrowed meaning.
As per 胥# (separate) + 女 woman → male separated from his own family in marrying into another → *son-in-law*; *bridegroom*.
不說皃。从女韋聲。
色好也。从女从美，美亦聲。
樂也。从女甚聲。
好皃。从女耎聲。
甘氏《星經》曰：“太白上公，妻曰女媊。女媊居南斗，食厲，天下祭之。曰明星。”从女前聲。
目裏好也。从女苗聲。
說樂也。从女巸聲。
As per 某# (abundance) + 女 woman → woman who acts as an *intermediary* between a man and a woman, the goal being to ensure the birth of abundant children.
謀也，謀合二姓。从女某聲。
女有心媕媕也。从女弇聲。
As per 眉# (long, curved eyebrow) + 女 woman → woman arching an eyebrow seductively → *flirt*; *seductive* → *flatter*. Also, *beautiful*.
說也。从女眉聲。
女 woman + 爰# (twist about) → twisting, alluring figure of a *beautiful woman* (compare 娟) → *princess*.
美女也。人所援也。从女从爰。爰，引也。《詩》曰：“邦之媛兮。”
諦也。一曰妍黠也。一曰江淮之閒謂母曰媞。从女是聲。
嬻也。从女枼聲。
As per 冐/冒# (wrap about the head) + 女 woman → (blind) *jealousy* → *envy* (← figurative types of blindness).
夫妒婦也。从女冒聲。一曰相視也。
諟也。从女染聲。
輕皃。从女扁聲。
楚人謂女弟曰媦。从女胃聲。《公羊傳》曰：“楚王之妻媦。”
古之神聖女，化萬物者也。从女咼聲。
巧黠也。从女俞聲。
婦人妊身也。从女芻聲。《周書》曰：“至于媰婦。”
曲肩行皃。从女䍃聲。
妃也。从女𣬉聲。

As per 朕# (rise) + 女 woman → women accompanying a bride (who is raised high and carried in a palanquin or similar conveyance) → *younger sister(s) or female servant(s) who accompany a bride to her new home* → *see off*; *female servant*.
奢也。从女般聲。

As per 𥁕 as described in 温 (hold in/down) + 女 woman → woman of low rank (← be of a class that is suppressed/held down) → *elderly woman*. Also, an appellation roughly equivalent to *grandma* (compare 嫗).
女老偁也。从女𥁕聲。讀若奥。
女 woman + 馬# for the sound alone to simulate the nursery term "ma(ma)" → *mother*.
As per 冓# (symmetry) + 女 woman → marry (← pair a man and woman) → *intimacy*.
重㛰也。从女冓聲。《易》曰：“匪寇，㛰媾。”
慙也。从女鬼聲。
家# household + 女 woman → woman sent to another household → *marry* (off a daughter) → *bride*; *one's wife*; *one's daughter-in-law*.
女適人也。从女家聲。
叟# elder + 女 woman → one's *elder brother's wife*.
台國之女，周棄母字也。从女原聲。
嬰嫇也。从女冥聲。一曰嫇嫇，小人皃。
小心態也。从女，熒省聲。
疾# illness + 女 woman → *jealousy*; *envy* (← unhealthy mental states regarded as characteristic of women). Compare 妬.
As per 弱# (supple) + 女 woman → supple/*limber* woman → *lithe*; *delicate*; *graceful*.
㚩也。从女从弱。

As per 兼# (gather then put/store away → keep concealed) + 女 woman → woman kept concealed → *disagreeable*/*unpleasant* (← disagreeable situation) → *hate*; *dislike*; *antipathy*; *unwilling to do* (← shrink from) → *doubt*.
不平於心也。一曰疑也。从女兼聲。
娚# a variant form of 喃 chatter + 女 woman → chatter with a woman → *play with*; *flirt*; *tease*. Compare 嬲.
As per 票# (light) + 女 woman → light, promiscuous woman → *promiscuity*.
輕也。从女𤐫聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 女 woman → *stooped, elderly woman*; *affectionate term of address for an elderly woman*. Compare 媼.
母也。从女區聲。
好也。从女旋聲。
As per 曼# (cover; be covered) + 女 woman → figuratively cover a woman with *scorn* → *look down on*; *despise*. Compare 侮.
侮易也。从女曼聲。
婗也。从女殹聲。
An abbreviated form# of 釐 (plow long, neat furrows) + 女 woman → *widow* (i.e. a woman whose husband has been buried like seeds in a furrow).
無夫也。从女𠩺聲。
As per 啇# (variant of 啻) (unify) + 女 woman → one's (legal) wife, part of the spousal unit → (legitimate) *heir*; (legitimate) *child*.
孎也。从女啻聲。
媞也。从女規聲。讀若癸。秦晉謂細爲嫢。
焉# swallow + 女 woman → charming, *beautiful woman*, likened to a swallow.
長皃。从女焉聲。
壹也。从女專聲。一曰嫥嫥。
齊也。从女責聲。
敕 a variant form of 勅, here a variant of 耎# (soft) + 女 woman → *young* (← young and therefore soft/supple woman). Compare 嬬.
婟也。从女翏聲。
侮易也。从女敖聲。
易使怒也。从女敝聲。讀若擊撆。
𠈃任也。从女辜聲。
As per 無# (concealed) + 女 woman → *charm*; *enchant* (← the alluring, concealed figure of a woman; compare 妄).
𡡾也。从女無聲。
南楚之外謂好曰嫷。从女隋聲。
好枝格人語也。一曰靳也。从女善聲。
雅也。从女閒聲。
閑# leisure + 女 woman → woman of leisure → *learn*; *be accomplished*; *elegant*; *refined* (← all by association with leisured women).
怒皃。从女黑聲。
女字也。从女尞聲。
靜好也。从女畫聲。
